BigQuery MERGE/INSERT cannot safely implement the claim contract: BigQuery DML uses optimistic concurrency with no row-level locking or PRIMARY KEY enforcement. Two concurrent MERGE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT statements can both succeed, creating duplicate claim records.
Firestore createDocument is atomic set-if-absent (HTTP 409 on conflict) — the correct primitive for the idempotency claim contract.
